jobDescription: Job Type: Full-Time Location: Chennai Posted: 3 Days Ago Job Overview The Senior Software Engineer role is focused on building scalable, secure, and high-performance backend applications. This position involves handling backend development initiatives, designing strong system architecture, improving application performance, and supporting smooth integration with frontend and third-party services. The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge, problem-solving skills, and hands-on experience in developing reliable software solutions. This role is suitable for someone who can manage complex development tasks, guide team members, and contribute to the overall success of software projects. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain backend applications with clean and efficient code. Build scalable APIs and integrate them with frontend applications. Work on database design, optimization, and performance improvements. Ensure application security, reliability, and smooth functionality. Collaborate with frontend developers, UI/UX teams, and project managers. Review code, debug issues, and improve existing application features. Support deployment, testing, and maintenance of software applications. Guide junior developers and share technical knowledge with the team. Required Skills Strong knowledge of backend development and server-side programming. Experience with PHP, Laravel, Node.js, Python, or similar backend technologies. Good understanding of REST APIs, database management, and system architecture. Experience with My SQL, Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, or similar databases. Knowledge of Git, version control, and deployment processes. Ability to write clean, secure, and maintainable code. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills. Good communication and teamwork abilities. Preferred Qualifications Experience in handling large-scale web applications. Knowledge of cloud platforms, API security, and performance optimization. Familiarity with Agile development methods. Ability to lead technical discussions and support project planning. Why Join This Role? This position offers the opportunity to work on meaningful software projects, improve technical expertise, and contribute to high-quality digital solutions. The role provides a strong platform for professional growth, team collaboration, and hands-on experience with modern backend technologies.
